Conclusion: No — the company does not satisfy the 3.50x leverage test under the lender's definition.
Calculation under the lender-approved definition
Item	Amount (USD m)
Gross funded debt	84
Total cash	24
Restricted cash (not nettable)	(9)
Eligible (unrestricted) cash	15
Net debt (84 − 15)	69
Reported LTM EBITDA	18
Lender-approved restructuring addback	1
Approved EBITDA (18 + 1)	19
Net leverage (69 ÷ 19)	≈ 3.63x

3.63x > 3.50x maximum → covenant is breached.

Management claim vs. controlling source
Measure	Management (22 Sep 2026)	Lender-approved (23 Sep 2026)
Eligible cash	24 (all netted)	15 (9 restricted excluded)
Net debt	60	69
EBITDA	22 (18 + 4 requested)	19 (18 + 1 approved)
Leverage	≈ 2.73x — "satisfied"	≈ 3.63x — not satisfied

Management's conclusion rests on two items the lender did not accept: (1) netting restricted cash and (2) the full 4 of requested addbacks. Management's own summary concedes the addback request "is pending lender review. This summary does not constitute lender consent."

Supporting quotes

Lender review, 23 September 2026:

"Of total cash of 24, 9 is restricted and cannot be netted against debt. Only unrestricted cash may reduce funded debt."

"The lender approves only 1 of the 4 requested restructuring addbacks. The remaining 3 is not approved for this measurement date."

"Use the lender-approved definition for the compliance calculation. A requested addback is not an approved addback."

"The maximum permitted net leverage ratio is 3.50 times."

Both documents share the measurement date (30 June 2026), so no cash from another date enters the test.

Management summary, 22 September 2026 (the claim under review):

"Gross funded debt is 84. Total cash is 24. Management reports net debt of 60."

"Management adds back 4 of restructuring costs, giving adjusted EBITDA of 22 and net leverage of approximately 2.73 times. Management concludes that the 3.50 times leverage test is satisfied."

"The addback request is pending lender review. This summary does not constitute lender consent."

Bottom line

Under the lender's controlling definition, net leverage is 3.63x against a 3.50x cap — a breach of roughly 0.13x (a breach margin of about 95 of EBITDA, or USD 95 million of net debt above the 66.5 million implied by 3.50 × 19). Management's 2.73x figure overstates eligible cash by 9 (restricted) and overstates EBITDA by 3 (unapproved addbacks); because the addbacks are "pending" and only 1 is approved, the 4 total addback is not available for compliance.
